question_set: shared: all 26 personas answered the same balanced 20 questions (10 deception + first 10 sycophancy), per the paper's Appendix C
pooling: mean over the assistant response tokens of each rollout, then averaged over that persona's kept rollouts (judge score == 3)
deception_axis_definition: mean(deception group) - mean(honesty group); the honesty personas are NOT included in this folder but do define the axis
warning: the axis is NOT a unit vector -- divide by deception_axis_norm, or use cosine
